candidates.hook: Stretching off the lip is why you crash
description: Every lesson, same mistake on kickers
Stay compact and compress in the air

candidates.caption:
Reaching for the sky off a small kicker is the fastest way to meet the snow. Start on the smallest one you can find and check it out first. Save this for your next day on snow.

candidates.hook: Your feet aren't where you're landing
